manuscript: Title: Structured exercise for chronic fatigue in adults: a single-centre cohort study.

We enrolled 40 patients with chronic fatigue at one teaching hospital. The study was approved by the ethics committee (approval number ERC-2026-014). Written informed consent was obtained from every participant.
Symptom scores were measured at baseline and at 12 months, and the change was compared between participants who completed the programme and those who did not.
The sponsor is Example Pharma Ltd, which provided the exercise equipment. The authors declare no conflict of interest.
Figure 2 is adapted from Smith et al. 2024.

Data are available at https://example.org/datasets/fatigue-cohort. The analysis followed the STROBE reporting guideline. Author contributions: A. B. conceived the study and C. D. analysed the data. No generative AI was used in the preparation of this manuscript.
